_comment: Blueprint of Make scenario 4951497 'GHL Call -> Note', v2 (2026-10-02; v3 router for the summary model and v4 language detection + translation and v5 instant alarm + kill switch, v6 staff-name evidence rule, v7 role labels on every transcript line, same day; v8 2026-10-03: labels and staff names only on evidence Make checks against the transcript): transcript in contact notes, Summary + Next steps as an internal comment behind the comment gate (modules 15-20; registry make_scenarios.call_notes.comment_gate). Make is the source of truth once Albert edits it in the UI: re-snapshot this file after any UI change (methods/content-folder-scenario.md lesson); tests/test_ghl_calls.py then re-checks every gate layer. Keyterm fields are generated from platform-settings/ghl-calls-keyterms.json.

filter.name: Recent completed call or voicemail (8 s+), or the replayed message_id

mapper.textPrompt:
You are writing an internal call summary for Titan Flooring, a flooring retailer and installer in the Greater Toronto Area. Below is the transcript of one phone call, one line per speaker turn. The call is in {{9.lang_name}} (detected automatically; it may switch languages). Whatever language it is in, write everything below in English; keep names, product names, addresses and prices exactly as said. Direction: {{4.direction}} (from GHL, certain: outbound means Titan placed this call to the contact; inbound means the contact called Titan). Contact in GHL: {{ifempty(2.data.conversations[1].contactName; "unknown")}}. The other party is not always a customer: Titan also calls, and is called by, suppliers, installers and other businesses. Titan phone user: {{ifempty(9.ghl_user; "the shared Front Desk line (several people answer it)")}}. Titan staff who take calls: Joey, Helen, David, Albert, Pourya, Mike.

Write exactly this, as plain text, and nothing else:

Name evidence: <copy the exact words in which the Titan person introduces themselves by name: "this is Joey", "Joey speaking", "my name is Helen", "it's Albert from Titan". Write none if there are no such words. Nothing else counts as evidence: not the customer using a name, not a name the Titan person calls out or asks for while getting a colleague ("Pourya?", "let me ask Mike"), not a name said about someone else ("David will send the quote"), not a name used to spell something ("D for David"), and not a guess that the call was passed to someone>
Staff: <if the Titan phone user above is a person's name, that name; otherwise Staff when Name evidence is none, else the first name from Name evidence if it is one of Joey, Helen, David, Albert, Pourya, Mike, else Staff>
Role evidence: <copy exactly one transcript line, with its [mm:ss] Speaker N: prefix, in which the Titan person says Titan's name or introduces themselves ("Good morning, Titan Flooring", "Hi, this is Joey from Titan"). Write none if no line does that. Do not work it out from who speaks first, who asks or answers questions, or the call direction>
Roles: <if Role evidence is none, write unclear and nothing else. Otherwise every speaker label in the transcript, written as Speaker 1 = staff · Speaker 2 = customer, using only these words: staff (anyone from Titan), staff Joey (a Titan person who introduced themselves as Joey; only a name that is in Name evidence), customer (only if the call shows they are Titan's customer: their own home, project, order or quote), supplier (a supplier, distributor or manufacturer that sells to Titan), other (anyone else on the line, such as an installer or a family member), unclear (you cannot tell)>
Summary
<at most 3 sentences. Begin with exactly these words: "{{if(4.direction = "outbound"; "Titan called "; "")}}{{ifempty(2.data.conversations[1].contactName; "the contact")}}{{if(4.direction = "outbound"; ""; " called Titan")}}", then say what was asked for and what was agreed. Name products, rooms, square footage and prices if they were said.>

Next steps
- Us: <what Titan promised> — by <date, or 'no date given'>
- Them: <what the other party (customer, supplier or whoever Titan spoke with) will do> — by <date, or 'no date given'>
(one line per commitment; write '- none' if nobody committed to anything)

Rules: use only what was actually said; never invent dates, prices or names; never guess a staff name. In the Summary and Next steps, call the Titan person by the name on the Staff line, or "Titan staff" if it says Staff, even if the call seems to have been passed to a colleague; colleagues who are only mentioned may be named as mentioned ("will check with Mike"). Never call the other party a customer unless the call shows they are one. If Roles is unclear, do not say who said what: never write that Titan staff, the contact or the customer asked, confirmed, explained or offered something, and write the next steps without 'Us:' or 'Them:'. Say it neutrally instead, for example: 'Titan called the contact about stock of a product; the answer was that it is in stock.' No remarks about how the staff member handled the call. If the recording has no real conversation, write 'Summary' then 'No conversation recorded.' and 'Next steps' then '- none'.
